name: tax-form-annotation-spec
description: Specification for annotating fields/boxes on U.S. tax forms, plus a proof-of-concept renderer that fills the real Form 1040 from a nested data set.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/renderer/render.js examples/f1040.annotation.json examples/sample-data.json examples/f1040--2025.pdf out/f1040-filled.pdf
scripts.demo:debug: npm run build && node dist/renderer/render.js examples/f1040.annotation.json examples/sample-data.json examples/f1040--2025.pdf out/f1040-debug.pdf --debug
